name: tradrl-time-machine
description: Time Machine point-in-time contract (W050, the W035–W048 flat source-exported package pattern): the PointInTimeQuery as typed DATA — a declared cutoff in W004's own time vocabulary (SimulationTimeMs, the simulation axis), the explicit tenant/project/world scope, the closed record-family set the query may view (the W004 market-event family + W027's four information record kinds), and the content-addressed pitq-<digest> query id. firewall.ts is THE KNOWLEDGE FIREWALL LAW as a typed gate (R016): sealView(query, records) proves every record ≤ cutoff through the records' own timestamps (W004's eventObservationTime law / W027's publication-time mapping law) and REFUSES any post-cutoff record loudly naming R016 — a sealed PointInTimeView structurally cannot reference anything recorded after its cutoff (never a convention); the sealed view carries its proof (which records, which timestamps, the firewall digest). A9: pure, deterministic, no clocks, no randomness, no env reads. A14: the machine assembles views — it never executes, never forecasts.
